entries.subject: a scrawny green gretchin with huge ears, a rusty blasta and a sack bulging with stolen dice. Small, green, and very interested in your dice.

entries.name: Ork Freeboota
entries.subject: a hulking green Ork freebooter in a stolen Imperial navy greatcoat with a choppa and slugga, grinning. A pirate Ork in a stolen naval coat, delighted to see you.

entries.name: Reaver Gunner
entries.subject: a gaunt void-pirate in patched flak with an autogun and a rebreather. Void-scum with a rifle and nothing left to lose.

entries.name: Rogue Servitor
entries.subject: a lobotomised cargo-servitor with a hydraulic claw arm and flickering optic. Still following orders from a captain dead three centuries.

entries.name: Heretek Void-Priest
entries.subject: a hooded heretek in black robes with tangled mechadendrites and a sparking staff. He prays to the machine, and the machine prays back wrong.

entries.name: Scavenger Gang
entries.subject: a pack of ragged scavengers with knives and stub revolvers, faces wrapped against the cold. Last month they were survivors in the enclave. Now they are hungry.

entries.name: Kaptin Gitsnik
entries.subject: a massive Ork kaptin with a bicorne hat, a power klaw, gold teef and a pet squig. He found a Fortress. He is keeping it. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Vassarine the Undrowned
entries.subject: a scarred renegade captain woman in a stolen ornate void-suit with a bolt pistol on a salvage throne. She took the Quays from a dozen crews. She would like your ship next. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Hullbreaker
entries.subject: a colossal spider-legged boarding machine with a drill prow and plasma vents. Built to eat ships. The Fortress fed it. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Spore-Thrall
entries.subject: a shambling human corpse sprouting glowing fungal growths from eyes and mouth. Explorers who breathed too deep. They grow mushrooms now.

entries.name: Renegade Kroot
entries.subject: a lean avian Kroot warrior with quills, a long bladed rifle and feather totems. It has tasted Ork. It wants to know what you taste like.

entries.name: Kroot Hound
entries.subject: a snarling beaked Kroot hound with quills and a long tail. Fast, beaked, and always in pairs.

entries.name: Stranglevine
entries.subject: a writhing mass of thorned carnivorous vines with a gaping flower mouth. The corridor is the predator.

entries.name: Venomwing
entries.subject: a bat-winged xenos insect with iridescent hypnotic wing patterns, dripping venom. Its wings are patterned to make you look away from your dice.

entries.name: Mycelic Herald
entries.subject: a tall mushroom-headed humanoid with a cloak of mycelium and a staff of living root. It speaks for the garden. The garden is hungry.

entries.name: The Bloom Queen
entries.subject: a vast carnivorous flower-queen with a humanoid figure grown into its pistil, surrounded by pollen. The garden has a mind, and it has noticed you. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Shaper Kh'rrak
entries.subject: an ancient Kroot shaper with long quills, ritual scars and trophies from many species. He has eaten a Rogue Trader before. He remembers the taste. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Gardener
entries.subject: a tall insectile xenos bio-construct of chitin and brass with shear-like arms tending alien plants. A leftover of the Yu'Vath, still tending a garden for masters long gone. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Rak'Gol Marauder
entries.subject: a towering reptilian Rak'Gol cyborg with crude bionic cleaver arms and rad-cannon. More machine than meat, and all of it hates you.

entries.name: Rak'Gol Dead-Eye
entries.subject: a lean Rak'Gol with a long crude rail rifle and multiple augmetic lenses. Its eyes were replaced with targeting arrays long ago.

entries.name: Drowned Servitor
entries.subject: a waterlogged curator servitor dripping coolant with a piston arm and stasis lamp. It guards the relics. It does not know they are drowned.

entries.name: Coolant Eel
entries.subject: a pale bioluminescent eel thick as a man, with frost on its fangs. Something evolved in the coolant. It glows.

entries.name: Heretek Adept
entries.subject: a renegade tech-adept with red robes stained black, multiple arms and a bundle of stolen relics. He came for the relics and stayed for the voices.

entries.name: Cryo-Wraith
entries.subject: a translucent screaming wraith of frost and warp-light rising from black coolant. A ghost of the warp, wearing the frost of the vaults.

entries.name: Rak'Gol Warlord
entries.subject: a massive Rak'Gol warlord cyborg covered in weapon-limbs and Imperial skulls. It has collected forty Imperial skulls. It needs four more for a set. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Archive-Mind
entries.subject: a vast cathedral of cogitators and data-cables with a single giant optic. The Reliquary's machine-mind. It catalogues everything, including you. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Drowned Confessor
entries.subject: a drowned undead preacher in rotted ecclesiarchal robes swinging a black censer, eyes glowing warp-blue. He came to bless the relics. Something in the deep blessed him back. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Eldar Corsair
entries.subject: a lithe Eldar corsair in mismatched armour with a power blade and shuriken pistol. Fast as thought, and it thinks you are slow.

entries.name: Corsair Void-Sniper
entries.subject: an Eldar sniper in a shimmering cloak with a long elegant rifle. You will not see it. You will see the flash.

entries.name: Shade-Double
entries.subject: a dark featureless reflection of a Rogue Trader stepping out of an obsidian mirror. It is you, from the wrong side of the glass.

entries.name: Labyrinth Warden
entries.subject: a faceless humanoid construct of black obsidian glass with glowing seams. The Fortress grows them like crystals.

entries.name: Whispering Shade
entries.subject: a wispy smoke-figure with too many mouths whispering in the black glass. It whispers what you owe. It is always right.

entries.name: Corsair Witch
entries.subject: an Eldar witch in a bone-white mask with spinning psychic runes and a singing spear. Her runes spin around her like moons.

entries.name: Prince Ilyrath
entries.subject: an arrogant Eldar corsair prince in ornate jewelled armour with a star-blade and a cloak of stars. He has raided the Expanse for three centuries and thinks it all rather dull. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Unmade
entries.subject: a cracked obsidian reflection of a Rogue Trader captain wearing a ghostly Warrant of Trade. It knows every hand you have played. It knows what you lost. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Obsidian Seraph
entries.subject: a six-winged angelic construct of black obsidian glass with a cracked halo of light. A sentinel the Fortress made in the image of something it once saw. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Blackstone Sentinel
entries.subject: a hovering black monolith construct with glowing runes and gravity-warped edges. The Fortress's immune system.

entries.name: Warp-Spawn
entries.subject: a twisting mass of warp-flesh with too many eyes and claws. It leaked through a crack in the Gellar of the world.

entries.name: Graviton Drone
entries.subject: a floating black drone with gravitic emitters bending the light around it. It weighs you, and finds you too light.

entries.name: Warp-Hound
entries.subject: a skinless daemonic hound with a collar of brass and burning eyes. It hunts by the smell of your soul.

entries.name: Chaos Cultist
entries.subject: a robed chaos cultist with a ritual knife, autopistol and a mutated hand. They came to worship the Fortress. It did not notice.

entries.name: Renegade Psyker
entries.subject: an emaciated renegade psyker with burning eyes and crackling warp lightning. Unsanctioned and unhinged. The warp sings through him.

entries.name: The Gravitarch
entries.subject: a giant humanoid construct of black stone with gravity distortion warping the air around it. The Fortress built it to keep the engine turning, and visitors flattened. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: The Hollow Saint
entries.subject: a beautiful haloed saint figure with an empty hollow behind its face, warp-light pouring out. It wears the shape of what you pray to. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Sorcerer-Lord Xaphan
entries.subject: a chaos sorcerer in ancient horned power armour wreathed in warp fire. He wants the Fortress for his masters. He has been here a very long time. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Lord-Captain Rathbone
entries.subject: a Rogue Trader usurper in black-and-gold armour fused with blackstone, holding a glowing Warrant of Trade atop a wrecked flagship. He broke your Dynasty, took your Warrant, and came here to make himself a god. A towering BOSS, filling the frame.

entries.name: Warp Entity
entries.subject: a half-formed daemon pouring out of a crack in reality. Called through by a psyker's mistake.

entries.subject: high angle looking down on the crowned helm of a slain colossal warlord rolling across a cracked black-stone floor, its vast armoured body sprawled in the background, fires burning, embers rising. Blazing orange firelight.

entries.name: boons
entries.subject: top-down view of a gambler's green felt cloth spread with bone dice showing pips, face-up tarot cards painted with a skull and an eagle, and a few strange relics, lit by a single candle. Deep green felt and candle gold.

entries.name: hoard
entries.subject: low angle up a mountain of plundered treasure: gilded armour, jewelled weapons, open chests spilling coins and glowing xenos relics around a broken throne, glinting in torchlight. Rich gold and jewel tones.

entries.name: scavenger
entries.subject: side view of a hunched scavenger-trader leaning over a cluttered stall wedged into a fortress alcove, lenses for eyes, bony fingers holding up a charm, hundreds of dice and relics hanging on strings around them, a swinging green lumen. Sickly green and rust.

entries.name: retreat
entries.subject: wide high view of a narrow gantry over an abyss, three tiny explorers running toward the warm lights of a ramshackle enclave, carrying a wounded comrade, the vast black-stone fortress mouth erupting with pursuing shadows behind them. Cold blue night, amber enclave lights.

entries.name: wiped
entries.subject: overhead view of a dented helmet and a dropped lumen lying in spreading blood on black stone, long claw marks gouged into the floor beside them, the lumen's beam pointing into darkness. Cold dead blue-grey light, blood red.

entries.name: captainLost
entries.subject: a captain's body lying in state on a stone bier draped in a noble house banner, a sword laid on the chest, rows of tall candles, a single beam of pale light falling from a high window in a dark chapel, mourners kneeling at the far edge. Pale silver light and candle gold.

entries.name: blooded
entries.subject: side view of a crowded enclave tavern of salvaged bulkheads, survivors cheering and raising tankards to a young explorer with a bandaged head, hanging lumens, steam and warmth. Festive amber and copper.

entries.name: dynastyEnded
entries.subject: close-up of a noble signet ring and a torn house banner drifting weightless in the void, behind them a gutted derelict starship being cut apart by scavenger torches, sparks streaming into the dark. Cold void black, scattered sparks.

entries.name: prologue
entries.subject: wide space battle: a vast ornate noble flagship being boarded and scuttled by a sleek rival warship, broadsides of fire between them, boarding torpedoes, debris and escape pods, the flagship listing toward a blood-red nebula. Red and gold.

entries.name: docks
entries.subject: close interior view inside a frost-covered lifeboat: a frozen pilot slumped over the controls, an open log-book on their lap, a noble crest painted on the bulkhead, frozen wrecks visible through the cracked viewport. Icy blue and white.

entries.name: gardens
entries.subject: night by an enclave campfire: a tall feathered xenos hunter with a long rifle crouches across the fire, offering a bone carving with one clawed hand, sparks rising between them. Warm firelight against teal jungle dark.

entries.name: reliquary
entries.subject: low angle in a flooded cogitator vault: one towering screen glowing green above black water, showing the outline of a starship beside a wax seal, cables hanging like vines, reflections rippling. Green glow on black water.

entries.name: labyrinth
entries.subject: black glass exploding into a thousand falling shards, in the largest shard the reflection of a cruel lord on a starship bridge, his hand sunk into black stone, rainbows of refracted light everywhere. Prismatic and violet.

entries.name: core
entries.subject: a colossal ring-shaped engine of black stone, larger than a city, falling still, warp-light dimming in its cracks, a narrow causeway leading across the void toward a distant glowing heart. Magenta warp-light fading to cold dark.

entries.name: finale
entries.subject: low angle up at a captain's throne on the overgrown bridge of a lost flagship fused into black stone, a cruel lord seated on it with a sealed parchment warrant in his fist, glowing veins of the fortress pulsing through his skin. Sickly green and gold.

entries.name: epilogue
entries.subject: close-up of a sealed parchment warrant resting on a brass lectern on a ship's bridge, golden dawn light pouring through the viewport beyond it, where a vast black-stone fortress dwindles among the stars. Golden dawn.
